name: Enterprise Security Assessment
description: Comprehensive multi-phase security assessment workflow covering reconnaissance, enumeration, vulnerability scanning, and analysis

params.scope: enterprise security assessment including reconnaissance, enumeration, vulnerability scanning, and penetration testing

params.command: dig {{variables.domain}} +short && echo '---' && dig {{variables.domain}} ANY +short && echo '---' && dig {{variables.domain}} MX +short && echo '---' && dig {{variables.domain}} TXT +short

params.code: return { auth: {{auth.result}}, page_info: {{page_info.result}}, headers: {{headers.result}}, cookies: {{cookies.result}}, forms: {{forms.result}}, js_sources: {{js_sources.result}}, secrets: {{secrets.result}} };
return { dns: {{dns_lookup.result}}, whois: {{whois.result}}, nmap: {{nmap_scan.result}}, ssl: {{sslscan.result}}, files: {{robots_txt.result}} };

params.command: nuclei -u {{variables.target}} -t cves/ -t exposures/ -t vulnerabilities/ -t technologies/ -severity critical,high,medium -o /tmp/nuclei_output.txt -json 2>/dev/null || echo 'nuclei: tool not available or error'
nikto -h {{variables.target}} -Tuning 123bde -Display V -Format txt -output /tmp/nikto_output.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 'nikto: tool not available or error'
gobuster dir -u {{variables.target}} -w /usr/share/wordlists/dirb/common.txt -t 10 -x php,html,js,txt,zip -k -q 2>/dev/null || echo 'gobuster: tool not available or error'
sqlmap -u '{{variables.target}}' --batch --risk=1 --level=1 --random-agent --timeout=30 2>/dev/null | head -100 || echo 'sqlmap: tool not available or no SQL injection found'

params.code:
const web = {{consolidate_web.result}}; const recon = {{consolidate_recon.result}}; const scan = {{consolidate_scan.result}}; return {
  target: '{{variables.target}}',
  auth_status: web.auth?.success ? 'authorized' : 'pending',
  security_headers: web.headers?.success ? 'checked' : 'failed',
  cookies_secure: web.cookies?.success ? 'checked' : 'failed',
  forms_analyzed: web.forms?.success ? web.forms.result?.form_count || 0 : 0,
  js_sources: web.js_sources?.success ? web.js_sources.result?.sources?.length || 0 : 0,
  secrets_found: web.secrets?.success ? web.secrets.result?.secrets?.length || 0 : 0,
  dns_resolved: recon.dns?.success,
  ports_open: recon.nmap?.success ? (recon.nmap.result?.match(/open/g) || []).length : 0,
  ssl_configured: recon.ssl?.success,
  vulnerabilities_found: scan.nuclei?.success || scan.nikto?.success || scan.sqlmap?.success
};
